picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission signals a whole-of-government commitment—15+ federal agencies under executive order—to use AI to accelerate scientific discovery, making this the umbrella story behind the week's wave of university and lab awards.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it the single largest concentration of Genesis Mission funding this week, illustrating how deeply DOE is betting on AI-for-science at national-lab scale.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as CSO, shows AI-driven materials discovery attracting serious commercial capital and translating academic research into a major startup.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's AGIS program to build generative foundation models and AI agents specifically for scientific research represents a genuine technical leap toward general-purpose AI scientists, not just applied tooling.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)

picks.editorial_note: USC's new AI turbulence models under Genesis Mission target a decades-old fluid dynamics problem with direct applications in energy and transportation efficiency.
picks.title: USC leads national AI research project to accelerate scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's lead role on six projects plus partnership on 17 others under Genesis Mission underscores how deeply AI, HPC, and quantum computing are now being fused into core national security science.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: NSF's separate $83 million investment in AI-ready data infrastructure addresses a critical bottleneck—usable scientific data—that complements the Genesis Mission's compute and modeling investments.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: NEURA Robotics and RWTH Aachen's new 3,000-square-meter physical AI training facility marks a concrete industry-academia investment in embodied, cognitive robotics beyond software AI.
picks.title: A Milestone for Physical AI | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: Penn Medicine's discovery of 'prionins'—novel antibiotic candidates mined computationally from prion-linked proteins—is a striking example of AI directly generating new drug leads against a hidden class of disease-linked molecules.
picks.title: AI uncovers potential antibiotics hidden in proteins linked to fatal brain disease | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's Genesis Mission awards, including AI/ML work tied to particle accelerator research, extend the initiative's reach into fundamental physics infrastructure.
picks.title: U.S. Department of Energy invests in Fermilab projects to accelerate AI-enabled scientific discovery
